data.dock_evidence: This Windows worktree cannot materialize the patched host at all: tests/harness-dock/host-patch-artifact.ts patchTouchedFiles() splits patch text on LF while the checkout is CRLF (core.autocrlf=true, i:w/crlf), so ensureViewedSessionHarness throws 'patch.diff touches no file' in beforeAll before any code under test runs. This is pre-existing and independent of this diff. Workaround used: an isolated LF snapshot next to this worktree (git -c core.autocrlf=false clone --branch <ticket branch>; the modified files copied in; bun install), which is the state a Linux/CI checkout has. Snapshot deleted afterwards.
